guidance: Illustrative automated screening only; consult current official legislation and qualified counsel.

rules.name: Product name is declared
rules.guidance: Confirm the packaged commodity is identified by its common or generic name.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: Net quantity is declared
rules.guidance: Confirm net quantity is present and expressed in an appropriate unit.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: Net quantity uses a recognized unit
rules.guidance: Confirm the declared quantity has a numeric amount and a recognized measurement or count unit.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: Maximum retail price is declared
rules.guidance: Confirm the maximum retail sale price is declared.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: MRP has a valid numeric format
rules.guidance: Confirm the MRP is legible and presented as a valid amount in Indian currency.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: MRP includes all taxes
rules.guidance: Confirm the declared MRP is inclusive of all taxes.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: Manufacturer or packer details are declared
rules.guidance: Confirm the responsible manufacturer, packer or importer details and address are declared.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: Manufacturing date is present and formatted
rules.guidance: Check applicable date declaration and legibility for this commodity.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: Address postal PIN has 6 digits
rules.guidance: Check that the relevant Indian postal address includes a six-digit PIN code.
rules.legal_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: FSSAI licence number has 14 digits
rules.guidance: For food products, verify the displayed FSSAI licence/registration number and its validity.
rules.legal_source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020

rules.name: Postal PIN code has 6 digits
rules.guidance: Check that the relevant Indian postal address includes a valid six-digit PIN code.
rules.legal_source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020; Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011, as amended

rules.name: Food date marking is present and formatted
rules.guidance: For food, verify applicable date marking such as expiry/use-by or best-before.
rules.legal_source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020

rules.name: Food date sequence is consistent
rules.guidance: When both dates are legible, confirm the expiry or best-before date follows the manufacturing date.
rules.legal_source: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
